name: forge-orm
description: Prisma-shape multi-database ORM/wrapper for MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, DuckDB & SQL Server from one codebase — typed geo / vector / JSON path / full-text search, no codegen, no query engine. Bring your own schema.
author: johnsonfash

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && npm run build:worker
scripts.forge:integration:pg: ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json integration-pg.ts && npm run forge:regression:pg
scripts.forge:regression:pg: ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-postgresjs-driver.ts && ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-v2.2-pg-extensions.ts
scripts.forge:integration:mongo: ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json integration-mongo.ts && npm run forge:regression:mongo
scripts.forge:regression:mongo: ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-mongo-value-field.ts && ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-groupby-distinct.ts && ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-mongo-driver.ts && ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-mongo-partial-index.ts && ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-v2.2-mongo-extensions.ts && ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-where-op-safety.ts
scripts.forge:integration:mysql: ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json integration-mysql.ts && npm run forge:regression:mysql
scripts.forge:regression:mysql: ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-mariadb-driver.ts && ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-mysql-partial-index.ts
scripts.forge:integration:sqlite: ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json integration-sqlite.ts && npm run forge:regression:sqlite
scripts.forge:regression:sqlite: ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-libsql-driver.ts && ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-tauri-sql-driver.ts && ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-sqlite-fts5.ts
scripts.forge:integration:duckdb: ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-duckdb.ts && ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json regression-geo-duckdb.ts
scripts.forge:integration: npm run forge:integration:sqlite && npm run forge:integration:pg && npm run forge:integration:mysql && npm run forge:integration:mongo
scripts.forge:bench:sqlite: SKIP_PG=1 SKIP_MYSQL=1 SKIP_MONGO=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:pg: SKIP_SQLITE=1 SKIP_MYSQL=1 SKIP_MONGO=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:mysql: SKIP_SQLITE=1 SKIP_PG=1 SKIP_MONGO=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:mongo: SKIP_SQLITE=1 SKIP_PG=1 SKIP_MYSQL=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:compare:pg: COMPARE=1 SKIP_SQLITE=1 SKIP_MYSQL=1 SKIP_MONGO=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:compare:mysql: COMPARE=1 SKIP_SQLITE=1 SKIP_PG=1 SKIP_MONGO=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:compare:sqlite: COMPARE=1 SKIP_PG=1 SKIP_MYSQL=1 SKIP_MONGO=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:compare:mongo: COMPARE=1 SKIP_SQLITE=1 SKIP_PG=1 SKIP_MYSQL=1 ts-node --transpile-only --project tsconfig.json bench/db-bench.ts
scripts.forge:bench:compare:gen: prisma generate --schema=bench/compare/pg.prisma && prisma generate --schema=bench/compare/mysql.prisma && prisma generate --schema=bench/compare/sqlite.prisma
scripts.forge:check: npm run forge:test && npm run forge:typesafety && npm run forge:autocomplete
scripts.forge:all: npm run forge:check && npm run forge:integration && npm run forge:bench
